0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_GREETING_NITOWIKWE_000_000
0.description: Thanks for coming, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We need all the help we can get to keep our new train running whisper-quiet.

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_GREETING_NITOWIKWE_000_001
1.description: Just who I was hoping to see! We're remodeling the carriage interiors for a more comfortable ride.

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_GREETING_NITOWIKWE_000_002
2.description: Have you any experience in mapmaking, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? We'd like to help our riders find their way around inside Vanguard.

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_GREETING_NITOWIKWE_000_003
3.description: The engineers need supplies to complete their tasks. I don't suppose you have any, do you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_GREETING_NITOWIKWE_000_004
4.description: Perfect timing, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! If you've brought any tracklaying materials, I'd be more than happy to take them off your hands.

43.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_TUTORIAL_000_000
43.description: Help Nitowikwe achieve her goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with her and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

54.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_TUTORIAL_001_000
54.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Nitowikwe's trust.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_TUTORIAL_001_001
55.description: With each successful delivery, Nitowikwe will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Nitowikwe's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about her.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_TUTORIAL_001_002
56.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Nitowikwe needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!

58.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_001_000
58.description: The key to keeping the train running quiet is to minimize creaks and groans. That's why we regularly polish any parts that are quick to wear, like the wheels.

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_001_001
59.description: As I've said, many passengers traveling out of the dome are at an age where rest is paramount. I'd like for them to be seated comfortably.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_001_002
60.description: So long as our maps are made with durable paper and long-lasting ink, they can be folded and unfolded as many times as necessary to get their owners through Vanguard.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_001_003
61.description: Engineers like Shenza and Zawpya are the grease that keeps our wheels turning. We'd be fools not to make sure their toolboxes are well stocked.

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_001_004
62.description: Train tracks aren't built solely with timber and spikes. It takes a great many materials to lay rail, and we require exceptional quality to ensure the safety of our passengers.

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_002_000
63.description: Creaky wheels get the grease around here! It's essential to minimize noise.

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_002_001
64.description: Our seats must not only be comfortable, but durable enough to withstand near-constant use around the clock.

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_002_002
65.description: Fade-resistant pigment is essential to retain the finer details of our maps. Without it, I fear our riders might lose their bearings entirely.

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_002_003
66.description: Any train that runs on ceruleum is bound to get sooty. Fortunately, this industrial-grade soap makes cleaning slightly less of a hassle for our engineers.

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_002_004
67.description: It takes a lot to lay a new trackbed. The hard gravel of the ballast has to work in conjunction with the railroad ties to support a weight of several thousand tonzes!

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_003_000
68.description: Ropefish oil is uniquely resistant to intense friction, which makes it the perfect lubricant for a massive machine with a lot of moving parts!

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_003_001
69.description: Historically, Turali travelers have used these glowing orbs in place of lanterns. I reckon they'll help to light the carriages during our evening service.

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_003_002
70.description: There's a reason these critters are named for their ink. <hex:021A020203>Highly<hex:021A020103> resistant to water. With a little refining, not even the heaviest downpour will be able to wash it away!

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_003_003
71.description: If there's one thing you ought to know about ceruleum-powered locomotives, it's that they get sooty fast. Luckily, sponges like these make cleaning a breeze.

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_KNOWLEDGE_NITOWIKWE_003_004
72.description: First we smash the shells, then mix the bits into our ballast. We've found that it improves drainage and helps the wood to last as long as possible.

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_JUDGEMENT_NITOWIKWE_000_000
73.description: When cutting corners could put passengers' lives at risk, I have to be a little picky about quality...but this should suffice! Thanks.

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_JUDGEMENT_NITOWIKWE_000_001
74.description: Now <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> is exactly what I'd hoped for. Rest assured, we'll be putting it to good use straightaway!

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_JUDGEMENT_NITOWIKWE_000_002
75.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you've outdone yourself! I could scour the Springs and never find something half as good as this!

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_JUDGEMENT_NITOWIKWE_000_003
76.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you've outdone yourself! I'll have you know, the boys and I look forward to your deliveries like nameday gifts!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_FULLBAG_000_000
77.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_FULLBAG_000_001
78.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Nitowikwe once more.

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_BEFRANKUP_NITOWIKWE_000_000
79.description: I know our engineers will be pleased as punch about this delivery. Wait here while I get it all squared away for 'em, would you?

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_BEFRANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_000
80.description: Perfect─I reckon that's the last of the materials we'll need to finish remodeling the passenger cars.

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_BEFRANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_000
81.description: With this, we've enough materials to place a free map on each passenger seat. Now we just need to print the damned things...

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_BEFRANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_000
82.description: Wait right here─I gotta show the boys! They'll be ecstatic! Hehehe...

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_002
84.description: As I was shelving the supplies, Wawlika got curious to see your handiwork. Suffice it to say you've exceeded his expectations, too.

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_005
85.description: We really owe you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. With our train running so quietly, the rroneek are back to grazing undisturbed, and the locals have you to thank for that.

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_008
86.description: Our passengers like it, too─and when they're happy, the Railing's happy.

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_009
87.description: Watching these dome folk cry tears of joy after being kept from Shaaloani for so long...I couldn't be prouder of our work.

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_010
88.description: Speaking of which, there was another project I'd like your help with. Give me some time to iron out the particulars, and I'll be in touch, all right?

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_001
89.description: We've been making slow, steady progress so far─whenever we can find time between rides.

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_002
90.description: After all, more comfortable interiors will bring in even more passengers eager to ride...

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_003
91.description: And with more passengers, our dream of rail expansion won't be far off!

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_006
93.description: Here to ride the rails, I take it? How can we help?

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_PASSENGER00909_002_007
94.description: Well, I need to visit a relative in Yyasulani, but...the train will only take me as far as Vanguard, right?

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_PASSENGER00909_002_008
95.description: I'd rather not wander around blindly inside that massive fortress. Could you tell me how to get through?

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_010
96.description: Can you handle this, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I daresay you know Vanguard better than any of us.

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_PASSENGER00909_002_011
97.description: Ah, I see. I think I've got it...probably... Eh, I'll figure it out! Thank you so much!

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_012
98.description: Hm... I'd rather send the poor soul with a guide, just to be safe. Do you reckon there are any dome dwellers planning to take the next northbound train...?

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_013
99.description: For my own peace of mind, I think I'll ask around. Wait here, all right?

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_001
100.description: Take a look, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I have here our first batch of maps!

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_002
101.description: In addition to the ones we'll be placing on each carriage seat, I figured we ought to keep a few in the office, too. What do you think?

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_WAWLIKA_003_003
102.description: I was wondering what's got our Nitowikwe in such a chipper mood! Nice to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I take it everything's going well?

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_WAWLIKA_003_006
103.description: Lately I've been planning out how we'll lay tracks through Vanguard to link back up with Yyasulani Station, but there are a fair few factors to consider─our budget not least among them.

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_WAWLIKA_003_007
104.description: In hindsight, it's more than I could have managed while running operations at the same time. Thank you both for enabling me to focus on this.

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_009
105.description: Pfft! Compared to the rail expansion project, this is like water rolling off a rroneek's back!

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_WAWLIKA_003_010
106.description: Gahaha! Oh, Nitowikwe, what would we ever do without you?

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_WAWLIKA_003_011
107.description: Right then, I should get back to work. Take it easy, <hex:020814E905FF076C6164696573FF08796F752074776F03>, and give me a shout if you need anything!

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_004_001
108.description: Guess what, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? When I showed them your latest delivery, they insisted on thanking you themselves!

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_SHENZA_004_002
109.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you rascally aspis! These supplies you brought us are better than I could have dreamed!

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_ZAWPYA_004_003
110.description: You should hear what the others are saying. They like the feel of the tools so much, they've half a mind to build another train!

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_SHENZA_004_004
111.description: It's about time! You know, I've been thinking─perhaps our next model ought to fly!

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_ZAWPYA_004_005
112.description: With the dome's technology, that may just be possible. But can it still be called a train if it doesn't need tracks...?

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_ZAWPYA_004_006
113.description: Then again, when it comes to trains, perhaps no dream is too big! If it were me, why, I'd recreate the Dawnblazer, armed to the spokes with weaponry!

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_004_007
114.description: We can discuss your ideas in further detail─<hex:021A020203>after<hex:021A020103> our railroad spans the length of Tural. Now, get back to work!

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_004_011
115.description: It's great to see the boys so passionate about their work. Thanks again, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_004_012
116.description: If you've a little more time to spare, I have an update about our progress.

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_100
117.description: Now then, I'd like to speak with you about the next project I have in mind─something I think our passengers need.

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_101
118.description: For the dome dwellers, some thirty years have passed, yeah? That would explain why so many of our southbound riders are middle-aged and older.

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_102
119.description: Yet save for our noise-dampening efforts, the train has largely remained the same, particularly the interior.

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_103
120.description: With poor lighting and hard wooden seats, I doubt our elderly passengers will find it as tolerable as before. So, it's time we made some improvements!

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_105
121.description: Going forward, we're looking for supplies or materials to brighten up and soften our carriage interiors. I hope we can count on you!

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_100
122.description: I'm back! Luckily, I managed to flag down a friendly Alexandrian to escort him.

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_101
123.description: Now that I think of it, I suspect that man's not the only rider with apprehensions about the fortress.

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_102
124.description: But we can't count on passing dome dwellers to do the job every time. We need a more reliable option...

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_A1_002_104
126.description: You clearly care for your ridership a great deal.

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_A1_002_105
127.description: Is that really the Railing's problem?

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_106
128.description: Our passengers are paramount. If you ask me, they're the only reason we have a business at all.

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_108
129.description: That's it... I've got it! The next project will have to wait─this takes priority!

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_109
130.description: Based on your descriptions of Vanguard's floorplan, we could print guidebooks and pass them out on every northbound service. Hard to get lost with a map in hand, right?

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_110
131.description: I'll see if I can get my paws on a printing press. Bring me the paper and ink, and you'll be rewarded with a publisher's credit on each copy! How's that sound?

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_100
132.description: That man... <sigh> Whenever he hears you're in town, he comes racing out to see you. 'Course, most of the time you're already gone by then...

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_101
133.description: Anyway, now that the mapmaking business is settled, there was another commission I wanted to ask of you.

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_102
134.description: This one's not for the riders, but the crew.

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_103
135.description: With the many modifications we made to reduce noise and repel the rroneek, the train now needs quite a lot of additional upkeep.

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_LCUT_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_106
136.description: So, I figured I'd do what I can to minimize the hassle by putting in an order for some top-notch maintenance supplies. Can I count on you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUPINFO_000_000
137.description: Nitowikwe is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Marriage Mediator<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUPINFO_000_001
138.description: Nitowikwe is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Customer Caretaker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUPINFO_000_002
139.description: Nitowikwe is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Engineering Advocate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUPINFO_000_003
140.description: Nitowikwe could not be happier with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Savior of the Railing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUPINFO_001_001
141.description: And yet, there is still much work to be done if the Xak Tural Railing is to continue operating smoothly. To that end, Nitowikwe has a new favor to ask of you...

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUPINFO_001_002
142.description: Your contributions thus far have kept the Railing rolling, but it seems Nitowikwe needs to speak with you...

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_AFTRANKUP_000_001
143.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Nitowikwe has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Nitowikwe and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_AFTRANKUP_001_001
144.description: A new quest continuing the story of the Xak Tural Railing is now available. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Nitowikwe will be updated.

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_000
145.description: I appreciate everything you're able to bring us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Because of you, I can manage operations from the driver's cab if need be.

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_001_001
146.description: And on my days off, whenever you're not around, I sit in the office and balance the books. It was rough going at first, but I've nearly got the hang of it now!

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_000
147.description: Thanks for another great delivery, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The boys get so giddy when we hear that you're coming─even Wawlika!

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_002_001
148.description: Then again, I reckon I'm no different. Getting my paws on those much-needed supplies is always the highlight of my day, but I'd be lying if I said your presence was any less heartening.

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_000
149.description: Our riders have never been happier, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and we owe it to you and your many contributions.

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_003_001
150.description: I see them off when they leave, and I'm there when they return a few days later. Sometimes they even greet me like we're old friends... It warms my heart like nothing else.

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_004_000
151.description: You're a real treasure, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I don't know what the Railing would do without you.

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_004_001
152.description: So, how are the Dawnservants faring of late? And, er...that Shetona fellow, whatever his name was... Tell them to come and enjoy a ride sometime, all right? I'd love to chat more.

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_005_000
153.description: Thanks for another great delivery, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Once I put these away, I think I'll head back to the station.

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_005_001
154.description: With Wawlika handling a greater share of administrative tasks lately, I've been spending more time at the throttle again. At this rate, we'll be back to our old jobs in no time!

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_006_000
155.description: On behalf of everyone at Xak Tural Railing, thank you for your dedication, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You're the ceruleum that keeps us rolling forward, and I can't wait to see what's ahead!

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_006_001
156.description: But expanding the rail isn't my only ambition for the future. I'd like to expand our family, too─y'know, have kids. Reckon the boys would spoil 'em rotten.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_RANKUP_NITOWIKWE_006_002
157.description: You wouldn't mind being an honorary <hex:020810E905FF0561756E74FF06756E636C6503>, would you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Haha!

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
158.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Nitowikwe. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER11_00909_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_002
160.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Nitowikwe as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
